name: release-notes-writer
title: Release Notes Writer
description: Turn merged PRs and commit history into audience-segmented release notes. Use when cutting a release, writing changelog entries, or preparing a customer-facing what's-new post.
author: borghei
use_when: Cutting a versioned release and needing notes in under an hour
Translating engineering commits into customer-readable value statements
Splitting one release into developer, admin, and end-user notes
Auditing a draft changelog for missing breaking-change callouts
Backfilling notes for releases that shipped undocumented
inputs: Version range or tag boundary (e.g. v2.3.0..v2.4.0)
Audience segments the notes must serve
Product vocabulary — the names customers actually use
